author: Emily Knebel

steps.title: Warm reagents to RT
steps.instruction: Allow the Bead‑Linked Transposomes (BLT) and Tagmentation Buffer (TB1) to come to room temperature.

steps.title: Program thermocycler for tagmentation
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler to the custom Tag program: preheat lid at 100 °C, then 55 °C for 15 min, then hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Make tagmentation master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample (volumes account for residual), combine 11 µl BLT and 11 µl TB1; multiply the volumes by the number of samples.

steps.title: Add master mix to DNA samples
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl of the tagmentation master mix to each 30 µl diluted DNA sample in PCR tubes or a 96‑well plate (final volume 50 µl).

steps.title: Run tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Place the tubes or plate in the thermocycler and run the custom Tag program.

steps.title: Prepare TSB and resolve precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare Tagmentation Stop Buffer (TSB). If TSB precipitates, heat at 37 °C for 10 min, vortex, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Program thermocycler for stop reaction
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler to the Stop Tagmentation program: preheat lid at 100 °C, 37 °C for 15 min, then hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Add TSB and resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl TSB to each tube/well from the tagmentation reaction and resuspend the beads by pipetting slowly ten times.

steps.title: Magnetic separation and first wash
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack, wait 2–5 min until the liquid clears, then add 100 µl Tagmentation Wash Buffer to the beads, pipetting slowly to avoid foaming.

substeps.instruction: Return tubes to the magnetic stand and wait until the liquid clears again.

steps.title: Second wash and retain supernatant
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash step (add 100 µl Wash Buffer, wait for clearing) but do NOT remove the supernatant after the final wash; keep it for downstream amplification.

steps.title: Thaw PCR mix and primers
steps.instruction: Thaw the Illumina Enhanced PCR mix (EPM), invert to mix and centrifuge briefly. Thaw the primers: Tn‑specific Random Hybrid and Shortened Adaptor 1.

steps.title: Assemble Illumina PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample (volumes account for residual), combine 22 µl EPM, 22 µl nuclease‑free water, 5 µl Tn‑specific hybrid primer, and 5 µl Shortened Adaptor 1 primer. Vortex and centrifuge at 280 g for 10 s.

steps.title: Add PCR mix to bead‑linked samples
steps.instruction: With the bead‑linked tagmented samples on the magnetic stand, remove and discard the supernatant, then immediately add 50 µl of the Illumina PCR master mix to each tube/well.

steps.title: Run first amplification program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for Tn‑Amplification 1:

substeps.instruction: Final extension: 10 min at 68 °C

steps.title: Assess library on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Take the remaining 5 µl of each reaction, add loading dye at the appropriate ratio, run on an agarose gel, and verify a smear of DNA fragments mostly >350 bp.

steps.title: Perform Ampure bead cleanup (first round)
steps.instruction: Clean up the first‑round PCR products with Ampure XP beads:

substeps.instruction: Bring Ampure beads to room temperature and vortex/invert the stock.
Add 45 µl Ampure beads (1:1 ratio) to each 45 µl supernatant.
Pipet each tube ten times or shake for 1 min (pipet slowly, solution is viscous).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place tubes on magnetic stand, wait ~3 min until clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl fresh 80 % ethanol (do NOT disturb beads).
Air‑dry beads for 5–15 min.
Add 32 µl Resuspension Buffer (RSB) and pipet to resuspend.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Place back on magnetic stand and allow to clear.
Transfer 20 µl of the cleared supernatant to a new tube or plate.

steps.title: Store remaining first‑round library
steps.instruction: Store the remaining 10–12 µl of the cleaned first‑round library at –20 °C (stable for at least 1 month).

steps.title: Thaw KAPA HiFi mix and primers (2nd)
steps.instruction: Thaw KAPA HiFi 2X ReadyMix, invert several times to mix, and centrifuge briefly. Thaw primers: Adaptor 2 hybrid and Shortened Adaptor 1.

steps.title: Prepare second‑round PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample (volumes do NOT account for residual), combine 25 µl KAPA HiFi 2X ReadyMix, 3 µl nuclease‑free water, 1 µl Adaptor 2 hybrid primer, and 1 µl Full‑length Adaptor 1 primer. Vortex and centrifuge at 280 g for 10 s.

steps.title: Add master mix to first‑round libraries
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl of the second‑round PCR master mix to the 20 µl first‑round library in each tube.

steps.title: Run second amplification program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for Tn‑Amplification 2:

steps.title: Purify second‑round PCR with beads
steps.instruction: Clean up the second‑round PCR using Sample Purification beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl (1:1 volume) room‑temperature Sample Purification beads to each 50 µl PCR reaction.
Incubate 15 min at room temperature.
Place tubes on magnetic rack and allow beads to clear.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl 80 % ethanol (do not disturb beads).
Air‑dry beads for 5 min, then remove from magnetic stand.
Resuspend beads in 32 µl Resuspension Buffer or EB Buffer (Tris‑HCl pH 8‑8.5).
Place tubes on magnetic stand until clear.
Transfer 20 µl of the cleared supernatant to a new tube (no beads).

steps.title: Store remaining second‑round library
steps.instruction: Store the remaining 10–12 µl of the second‑round amplicon at –20 °C.

steps.title: Thaw KAPA HiFi mix and primers (3rd)
steps.instruction: Thaw KAPA HiFi 2X ReadyMix, invert several times, centrifuge briefly. Thaw primers: Adaptor 2 hybrid and Shortened Adaptor 1.

steps.title: Prepare third‑round PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample (volumes do NOT account for residual), combine 25 µl KAPA HiFi 2X ReadyMix and 3 µl nuclease‑free water. Vortex and centrifuge at 280 g for 10 s.

steps.title: Add index adapters to master mix
steps.instruction: Add indexing primers according to the Adaptor Pooling Guide:

substeps.instruction: 1 µl i7 index and 1 µl i5 index, OR
2.5 µl each i7 and i5 index plus 0 µl water to the master mix.

steps.title: Add master mix to second‑round libraries
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl of the indexed third‑round PCR master mix to the 20 µl second‑round library in each tube.

steps.title: Run third amplification program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for Tn‑Amplification 3:

steps.title: Perform bead cleanup (third round)
steps.instruction: Repeat the bead‑cleanup procedure described in steps 15‑16 (Ampure bead cleanup) on the third‑round PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Add 1:1 volume of Ampure beads, incubate 5 min, magnetic separation, two 200 µl 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 5‑15 min, resuspend in 32 µl RSB, magnetic clear, transfer 20 µl supernatant.

steps.title: Store final library aliquots
steps.instruction: Store 10–12 µl of the third‑round amplicons at –20 °C.

steps.title: Quantify libraries by Qubit
steps.instruction: Take 5 µl of each library, vortex, centrifuge, and quantify DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Submit libraries for analysis and sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit 20–30 µl of the final library for fragment analysis and sequencing on the appropriate platform.
